summary: opencode (anomalyco/opencode) is a Bun/TypeScript coding agent whose CLI entrypoint is packages/opencode/src/index.ts (yargs; `opencode run [message..]` is the non-interactive one-shot mode). It calls models through Vercel AI SDK provider packages; a provider is enabled when its models.dev env var is set (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for anthropic), and the endpoint can only be overridden via config (`provider.<id>.options.baseURL`, injected with OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT) because no *_BASE_URL env vars are read. The built-in `openai` provider uses the Responses API, so the recipe routes through the `anthropic` provider (@ai-sdk/anthropic, POST $PROXY_URL/v1/messages, SSE streaming, tool calls). The overlay compiles the official single-file binary (packages/opencode/script/build.ts --single, the same path as the upstream Docker/nix builds) into /opt/harness/bin/opencode with an embedded models.dev snapshot; `run --auto` auto-approves tool permissions, `--format json` streams the raw event trajectory to stdout (tee'd to /out/), and the task text is fed on stdin because positional messages containing spaces get wrapped in quotes by the CLI.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=debian:bookworm-slim
FROM ${BASE}

# Self-contained runtime under /opt/harness: Bun (build tool + compile target) and the compiled opencode binary.
ARG BUN_VERSION=1.3.14
ENV BUN_INSTALL=/opt/harness/bun
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/bun/bin:$PATH

# ripgrep: opencode uses a system `rg` when present, otherwise it downloads one at run time (no network in the sandbox).
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git unzip ripgrep \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s -- "bun-v${BUN_VERSION}" \
 && /opt/harness/bun/bin/bun --version

COPY . /opt/harness/src

# Install only the `opencode` workspace (plus its workspace deps).
# --ignore-scripts: the only lifecycle scripts Bun would run are optional native rebuilds (tree-sitter via node-gyp,
# which needs python + a C++ toolchain we must not add to task images; opencode loads the .wasm grammars instead),
# husky's git-hook setup (.git is not in the build context) and the root fix-node-pty chmod, which is run explicitly.
RUN cd /opt/harness/src \
 && bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --filter opencode \
 && bun run --cwd packages/core fix-node-pty

# Compile the single-file opencode binary the same way the upstream release / nix builds do.
# OPENCODE_VERSION / OPENCODE_CHANNEL are required because the version helper otherwise shells out to git / npm.
# The build embeds a models.dev snapshot, so no model-catalog fetch is needed at run time.
RUN cd /opt/harness/src/packages/opencode \
 && export OPENCODE_VERSION="$(bun -p "require('./package.json').version")" OPENCODE_CHANNEL=latest HOME=/tmp/opencode-build-home \
 && bun run script/build.ts --single --skip-install --skip-embed-web-ui \
 && install -Dm755 dist/opencode-linux-*/bin/opencode /opt/harness/bin/opencode \
 && rm -rf /tmp/opencode-build-home dist

# Login shells (`bash -lc`) re-read /etc/profile, which resets PATH on Debian/Ubuntu; keep the harness reachable there too.
RUN printf 'export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/bun/bin:$PATH\n' > /etc/profile.d/opencode-harness.sh \
 && ln -sf /opt/harness/bin/opencode /usr/local/bin/opencode
run_command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p /out; printf '%s' "$TASK" | opencode run --auto --format json --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5 --print-logs --log-level INFO 2>/out/opencode.log | tee /out/opencode-events.jsonl
notes: VERIFIED on debian:bookworm-slim (arm64 host): image builds (bun install --ignore-scripts --filter opencode resolves 535 packages; script/build.ts compiles the binary, version 1.18.32); check_command passes under `bash -lc`; run_command with a mock Anthropic server at $PROXY_URL produced POST /v1/messages requests (x-api-key: proxy, anthropic-version header, anthropic-beta interleaved-thinking/fine-grained-tool-streaming, main request model claude-sonnet-4-5, streaming), printed step_start/text/step_finish JSON events to stdout and /out/opencode-events.jsonl, wrote logs to /out/opencode.log, and exited 0. Note opencode also fires a small side request for session title generation (model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 from the catalog, with thinking enabled) through the same proxy; the proxy's model replacement covers it. The build on buildpack-deps:jammy was still in progress when this answer was forced; it uses only apt + curl and the same steps, so it is expected to behave identically. First attempt without --ignore-scripts failed: tree-sitter-powershell's install script runs node-gyp (needs python/C++), while opencode only imports its .wasm grammar, so lifecycle scripts are skipped and the only needed postinstall (packages/core fix-node-pty chmod) is run explicitly. The first end-to-end attempt failed with `opencode: command not found` because `bash -lc` re-reads /etc/profile which resets PATH; fixed with /etc/profile.d/opencode-harness.sh plus a /usr/local/bin symlink. Routing facts from the source: no OPENAI_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL support; endpoint comes from config provider.anthropic.options.baseURL (docs/providers.mdx) via OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT (merged last, highest precedence); the config also declares the model so it exists even if the embedded models.dev snapshot lacks that ID. The built-in `openai` provider calls the Responses API, which the proxy lacks; an alternative would be a custom provider with npm @ai-sdk/openai-compatible and baseURL $PROXY_URL/v1. `run` denies question/plan-mode permissions and, with --auto, approves all other permission requests (without --auto they are auto-rejected). The task is piped on stdin because the CLI wraps space-containing positional args in escaped double quotes before sending them; stdin must be closed or `run` blocks reading it (stdin is not a TTY), which printf guarantees. Run-time side effects: sqlite db/logs under ~/.local/share/opencode and ~/.cache/opencode; a background `@opencode-ai/plugin` npm install into ~/.config/opencode fails harmlessly offline (warning only). System `rg` from apt avoids a ripgrep download. Set OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1 if task repos should not contribute their own opencode.json/.opencode directories.
